author: Calagopus
tagline: Game server panel with a built-in Wings node and extension toolchain
description:
Calagopus is a modern, open-source game server management panel built with Rust and React. Deploy, monitor, and manage Minecraft, Hytale, and other game servers with industry-leading performance.

Calagopus comes in three variants:

- **Calagopus**: just the panel. Connect one or more separate Wings nodes to run game servers.
- **Calagopus AIO**: the panel plus an integrated Wings node, so you can create and run game servers on this device right away. The best choice for most people.
- **Calagopus Heavy AIO**: everything in AIO, plus the toolchain to compile backend extensions on the device. Only pick this if you need backend extensions.

You are viewing: **Calagopus Heavy AIO**.

tips.before_install:
An encryption key is generated automatically on first start and stored in `/DATA/AppData/<app>/data/.encryption-key`. Back it up together with the database: without it, encrypted data cannot be recovered.

To use your own key instead, set `APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY` before the first start. Do **not** change it after installation.

This app needs access to the Docker socket to run game servers, and uses port `2022` for SFTP. Install only one Calagopus AIO variant at a time.

Applying backend extensions triggers a local Rust build that can take several minutes and use significant CPU, memory and disk space.
